story: Demoscene accepted as UNESCO cultural heritage in Germany
text: I had a 386/40DX that could run Second Reality, and I was blown away. When I upgraded to a 486/66DX2 the first thing I did was run Second Reality, and I was shocked at how much of the demo content I had missed before from parts being truncated. Also it’s worth noting that a lot of Second Reality’s source code got released to GitHub several years back: [LINK] and here’s an incredibly deep dive into the code: [LINK] Finally, here’s some rare footage of the creation of the legendary demo: [VIDEO] (English subtitles available)
this video showed up in a recent thread about Second Reality and I had never seen it, so this audience may enjoy that, too: [VIDEO] ("Making of Second Reality / Future Crew")
Wow check out 1993 - we have come soooo far: [VIDEO] Listen to those hard drives! Netscape Navigator didn't come out until over a year later (December 1994) and IE 1.0 another year after that. Wow.

story: DJ rig with two Amiga 1200 PCs
text: I do. They ushered a new era on the PC, where PC finally had something that could compare with the demo quality of Amiga demos. To be more concrete, it was "Second Reality" that they did it with: [LINK] and here's Future Crew making it: [VIDEO] Europe and Summer school holidays. Perfect time to code.
